description: A reconstruction capture includes its own synthetic read and excludes a later synthetic close (engine §4 and §7).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a X [+T] [+U]
%rule b X [+T] [+U] [+V]
%rule c $x(body) U
%conditions matches(without-elision($x), rival), ¬matches(without-elision($x), wrong)
%rule body X T
%rule rival X [+T]
%rule wrong X [+T] [+U]
